sources.title: Qwen3.5-0.8B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-0.8B Ultra‑compact 0.8B parameter model from the Qwen3.5 series for edge deployment. Qwen3.5 is the latest multilingual language model series from Alibaba Cloud with improved reasoning and instruction‑following capabilities over Qwen3.

sources.title: qwen3.5:0.8b - ollama.com
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 represents a significant leap forward, integrating breakthroughs in multimodal learning, architectural efficiency, reinforcement learning scale, and global accessibility to empower developers and enterprises with unprecedented capability and efficiency.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-0.8B | Awesome Agents
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-0.8B is the floor of the Qwen 3.5 Small Series - and it's a remarkably high floor. Under a billion parameters, this model natively processes text, images, and video, supports 262K context, covers 201 languages, and posts MathVista 62.2 and OCRBench 74.5. It runs on around 1.6GB of VRAM at full precision and fits on a phone with 4-bit quantization.

sources.title: Qwen3.5 0.8B - Jetson AI Lab
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 0.8B is the smallest vision-language model in the Qwen3.5 lineup. It is designed for lightweight local multimodal inference, fast iteration, and efficient Jetson deployment.

sources.title: Run & Benchmark Qwen3.5 0.8B: Smallest Multimodal AI Model
sources.snippet: Quick answer. Qwen3.5 0.8B is Alibaba's smallest multimodal model, with a 262K context window and native vision support. Pull it with `ollama run qwen3.5:0.8b` for text or run the GGUF in llama.cpp for image input. Expect strong recall but weak code accuracy — bump to Qwen3.5 4B for any coding task.
